title: Watch appetite grow before it rules you
summary: This meets desire before it has fully named itself as need. The line traces how appetite grows by stages until it begins ruling the life.
takeaway: Notice appetite before it becomes destiny.
lifeApplication: At the first reach for food, comfort, attention, or purchase, pause early rather than late. Greed is easier to tell the truth about before it calls itself normal.

source.shortMeaning: Greed grows by stages until appetite starts running the life.
source.lifeApplication: Catch the want early, before it settles in as identity.
